design: Restart H280 KL adapter, same64 reads and normalizers. Loss intactKL+.1 correctionEnergy/baseStateErrorEnergy+lambda*baseTrainingKL*responseMSE/baseResponseErrorEnergy. Exact response quadratic statistics over actual/angle full removals, fit heads0:6. First768 train,next256 validation. All8 runs retained. Select min validation intactKL among checkpoints with <=2% loss vs H280 and responseMSE<=base separately for actual/angle fit heads. If none, select minimum intactKL/H280KL+max response ratio and label fallback. Heldout heads6:9 never select.

gates.state_retention: all-head vs validation-selected zero-strength intact KL lower95 reduction>=-.02
gates.base_retention: response error vs base lower95 reduction>=-.02 in all4 groups
gates.specialist_retention: response error vs matching split specialist lower95 reduction>=-.02 in all4 groups
gates.response_gain: actual response error vs H280>=5% and lower95>0 in both groups

scope: Compare all-head readout with forward/reverse specialists, zero-strength control,H280 and base. All9 heads supervised; separate former head groups. One fixed readout family, not intrinsic capacity bound.
fixed_candidate: lambda10.0_lr0.1_s300 in both fits, chosen from H285 before H286 outcomes; secondary diagnostic
